test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Higher Secondary Level) Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jul, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Convert the following indirect sentence into direct speech. Choose the most accurate option.

The child exclaimed with joy that he had won the race.

options.text: The child said, "I have won the race!"
The child exclaimed, "I have won the race!"
The child said, "Hurrah! I have won the race!"

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Direct Speech:** The child said, "Hurrah! I have won the race!"
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"exclaimed with joy" becomes "Hurrah!"**
 
 
• In indirect speech, when a person expresses happiness, the phrase "exclaimed with joy" is used to replace interjections like <strong&
